item.title: How to Make Money in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Wondering how to make money in RimWorld? Here are the most reliable income sources for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Quick Answer Tailoring and crafting (clothes, weapons, art) are the best stable income. Grow cash crops like smokeleaf or cotton, then sell goods at a trade outpost or caravan. Best Income Sources MethodIncome potentialEffort Tailoring (craft clothes)High, steadyLow–medium Art / sculpturesVery highMedium (needs Artistic pawn) Cash crops (smokeleaf, cotton)HighLow Drugs (yayo, flake)Very highLow (has risks) Caravan tradingHighMedium–high Tips Sell to outlanders and settlements — prices are better than at your own colony.

item.title: How to Recruit Prisoners in RimWorld (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: How to recruit prisoners is one of the most common RimWorld questions. Here's the reliable method for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Quick Answer Capture an enemy pawn, keep them fed and healthy, reduce their resistance to zero, then recruit them repeatedly until they join. Step-by-Step Capture — Down an enemy without killing them, then assign them to a prisoner bed (Medical tab). Keep them fed — Prisoners need food and medical care or they'll try to escape.

item.title: RimWorld Defense Layout Guide — Kill Box, Walls & Turrets (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: A good RimWorld defense layout is the difference between losing a colony and losing nothing. Here's how to design defenses for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Core Defense Principles Funnel the enemy: walls force raiders through one choke point (kill box). Cover beats numbers: sandbags, embrasures and walls give your shooters a 50%+ edge. Turrets absorb: autocannons and mini-turrets tank fire while pawns shoot from cover. Multiple layers: a perimeter wall plus interior bunkers saves the colony when one line falls.

item.title: RimWorld MOD Load Order — Fix Broken & Duplicate MODs (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: A wrong MOD load order breaks RimWorld saves and features. This guide explains how to order MODs and fix problems for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Correct Load Order Core frameworks (HugsLib, Harmony, etc.) — always first. Content expansions (Vanilla Expanded, new items/races). Gameplay / balance MODs (Combat Extended, etc.). UI and quality-of-life MODs last. Fix a Broken Save Disable the newest MODs you added first. If the save loads, re-enable one at a time to find the culprit.

item.title: RimWorld Prisoner Management Guide — Recruit, Convert & Keep (1.6 & Odyssey)
item.description: Good RimWorld prisoner management turns captured raiders into colonists. Here's the full workflow for the current 1.6 / Odyssey version. Food: deliver meals manually or via a prisoner stockpile. Security: doors on prisoners, keep weapons out of reach. Recruitment Workflow StepWhat to do 1.
